methods.name: tasks.start
methods.description: Start a fully private app-owned Agent run. Default one-shot runs directly deliver without interactive replies; media generation uses the selected user-owned service and its existing authorization. They archive final files into appFiles then clean execution context, even after page closure. Optional deliverable requires a matching saved media file; text allows a direct text answer. Optional output records advisory aspect and format preferences, requires deliverable, and is part of request identity. Include creative preferences in prompt or attached brief for the Agent; they do not enforce tool arguments or fail completed output. Duration is also guidance. keepSession=true retains context for multiple turns; reuse its opaque sessionId with a new requestId. Concurrent turns are rejected. A retained session keeps its initial media selection; repeat that selection on each turn and start a new session to change it. Reuse requestId to retrieve admission after an uncertain response; changed input conflicts. Closing the app does not stop an admitted task. Files are relative cloud appFiles paths. Optional media uses a current tasks.services identity; only that service is used for that media kind, without changing global priorities.

methods.name: tasks.get

Only retained sessions and historical interactive receipts expose forms or permission interactions; use tasks.respond for those. New one-shot runs never expose a reply channel. Unknown is not success.

methods.name: tasks.cancel

methods.name: tasks.release

methods.name: tasks.respond
